decisions.why: Examples are ankle and calcaneal plating systems — orthopaedic implants for foot and ankle
Examples include Acu Loc wrist plating systems and wrist spanning plates — orthopaedic hand and wrist implants
Examples are headless compression screw systems and cannulated screw systems — orthopaedic trauma fixation screws
Examples include clavicle plating systems and proximal humeral plating — orthopaedic shoulder implants
Examples include bone graft harvesting system and orthobiologic products (Callos, Abryx Montage) — orthopaedic biological implants and materials
Examples are anatomic radial head systems and elbow plating systems — orthopaedic elbow implants
Examples include suture anchor systems and syndesmosis repair systems — orthopaedic soft tissue and ligament fixation
